paper_title: First Search for Axion-Like Particles in a Storage Ring Using a Polarized Deuteron Beam
notes: First search for ALPs using a storage ring with polarized deuteron beam at COSY. The paper reports a 90% confidence level upper bound on the oscillating EDM component of the deuteron: |d_d^AC| < 6.4 × 10^-23 e·cm in the frequency range 120.0–121.4 kHz, corresponding to axion mass range m_a = 0.495–0.502 neV/c^2 (or 4.95–5.02 × 10^-10 eV). The bound is mass-independent within this narrow range and is encoded as a horizontal line. The paper also provides bounds on related couplings: g_a^dγ (axion coupling to deuteron EDM operator), C_G^d/f_a (ALP-gluon coupling), and C_d/f_a (ALP pseudo-magnetic coupling to deuteron spin via axion-wind effect). The experiment used four beam bunches with different polarization directions to sample all possible phases of the unknown ALP field. No ALP resonance was observed.
